Counterpoint Research today published a report pointing out that in the second quarter of 2026, Apple once again occupied five spots among the world's top ten best-selling smartphones. The details are as follows.

MagSafe and higher storage capacity help iPhone 17e break into the top ten

Over the past few months, numerous reports have pointed to the success of the iPhone 17 series, mainly because most of Apple's major competitors raised their product prices amid ongoing component shortages.

A few days ago, Counterpoint published three reports showing that Apple has bucked the trend across multiple regions, with growth in both shipments and sales.

The institution today published a new report, stating that the iPhone 17 became the world's best-selling smartphone in the second quarter of 2026, accounting for 6% of global smartphone sales.

Apple also secured second and third place with the iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPhone 17 Pro respectively, while the iPhone 17e ranked seventh and the iPhone 16 came in tenth. The latter had topped the chart a year earlier with a 4% market share.

Samsung was the only other manufacturer to make it into the top ten list, with the Galaxy S26 Ultra 5G in fourth place, followed by the Galaxy A07 4G (fifth), Galaxy A17 5G (sixth), Galaxy A17 4G (eighth), and Galaxy S26 5G (ninth).

Counterpoint also noted that the top ten best-selling smartphones accounted for 26% of total sales, up 2% year on year.
